energy.label: Energy
energy.description: Activated, social, and ready to move.

sad.label: Sad
sad.description: Emotionally low, reflective, and needing gentle support.

angry.label: Angry
angry.description: Activated, frustrated, and carrying sharp emotional charge.

gloomy.label: Gloomy
gloomy.description: Flat, drained, and muted by stress or emotional fog.

calm.title: Box Breath Reset
calm.prompt: Breathe in for 4, hold for 4, out for 4, hold for 4. Repeat four rounds.

energy.title: Momentum Sprint
energy.prompt: Use your current energy on one small win: tidy, stretch, or ship one unfinished task.

happiness.title: Amplify the Good
happiness.prompt: Lock in the high by naming one win, one person, and one moment worth remembering.

focus.title: Two-Minute Focus Lock
focus.prompt: Silence one distraction and commit to two minutes of deep attention on the next action.

peace.title: Gentle Reflection
peace.prompt: Stay in the pocket. Breathe slowly and note what made today feel safe or clear.

sad.title: Small Lift Challenge
sad.prompt: Pick the smallest caring action available: water, sunlight, or one supportive message.

angry.title: Decompression Drill
angry.prompt: Release charge before reacting: unclench jaw, drop shoulders, breathe long on the exhale.

gloomy.title: Fog Breaker
gloomy.prompt: Beat the emotional fog with light motion and one concrete action you can finish fast.
